title: ProxyPlayer
description: Powerful player simulation for Paper 1.21.11. Spawn persistent proxies to load chunks, run farms, and test redstone without extra accounts.
body:
ProxyPlayer brings a "fake player" utility to your paper server. These "fake players" can perform actions like moving, breaking and placing blocks and more.
      
**FYI:** By using the word proxy, we refer to a fake player that performs configurable actions like moving or jumping, not an external server where a connection is routed to.

# Features
- Chunk & Entity Loading: Proxies load chunks and allow entities to move.
- Farm Activation: Proxies always load farms and allow them to work without any real player interaction.
- Configurable actions: Proxies can perform configurable actions like moving or breaking blocks. 

# Commands:

Base Command: _**/player (aka: /fp)**_

**All commands listed can be used with /fp instead of /player.**

# Spawning and Management:

**_/player list_**:  List all currently active proxies

**_/player <name> spawn_**:  Spawn a proxy at your current position.

**_/player <name> spawn last_**: Spawn a proxy at its last saved location.

**_/player <name> spawn at <x> <y> <z>_**:  Spawns a proxy at specific coordinates.

**_/player <name> despawn_**: Removes the proxy and saves it's data.

# Proxy actions:

**_/player <name> attack [once|continuous|interval in seconds]_**: Hits an entity in range otherwise just swings their arm

**_/player <name> use [once|continuous|interval in seconds]_**: Interact with blocks or items.

**_/player <name> stop_**: Immediately cancels all actions.

**_/player <name> move [direction] [speed]_**: Moves the proxy at a certain direction at a specific speed; this feature is experimental and may not work as intended.

**_/player <name> look [at|direction]_**: Makes the proxy look at an entity or a specific direction.  

**_/player <name> drop / dropall_**: Drop the proxy's held item.

# Installation

Simply download the plugin and drop it in your server's ```plugins``` folder and you're done!

# Dependencies:
- Minecraft 1.21.x
- Paper / Purpur 1.21.x
